name: print-social-myths-facts-stress-post-black-glowing-glass-chat-bubbles
title: 'Myths & Facts On Stress' post with glowing frosted-glass chat bubbles marked by a red X and green tick
whatItIs: A black square post with a ghosted 'Myths & Facts' word repeated behind, two frosted-glass chat-bubble panels glowing green at the edges: one marked with a red X labelled 'Myth' stating a misconception, one marked with a green tick labelled 'Fact' correcting it, with social icons in the footer.
whatItMeans: Trustworthy and clear; the myth/fact contrast with colour-coded icons makes correcting misinformation feel authoritative yet simple.
techniques: Pair a myth and its correcting fact in matching glass bubble shapes.
Mark right and wrong with a consistent tick/cross icon system.
Ghost the topic word behind the content for texture.

vocabulary.definition: A content format contrasting a misconception with the correct information.
